articles.author: Dan Lamothe
articles.title: Pentagon prepares for potential surge of naval forces in Middle East - The Washington Post
articles.description: The U.S. military may soon have three aircraft carriers in the region as the Trump administration figures out its next steps in the months-long war with Iran.
